To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. David Turner, Trinity Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

I am writing from Trinity Family Practice to request cardiology assessment of Brian Dawson, a 64-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

Over the past three months, he has developed increasing breathlessness when walking uphill or climbing stairs. He denies breathlessness at rest and would like assessment of this change.

Most recent potassium is 5.9 mmol/L.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. David Turner
Trinity Family Practice
